sketch_notes: Both sketches depict a largely static reading/article layout with header links, long text sections, adjacent post links, and footer columns. No explicit mobile hamburger, dropdowns, tabs, accordions, search, modal triggers, sticky behavior, load-more controls, or other dynamic widgets are drawn. The visible buttons appear to function as ordinary links/CTAs rather than implying JavaScript-specific interaction. Cross-viewport differences appear to be responsive reflow only, which can be handled with CSS rather than JavaScript.
